features.name: Bundled public-handbook launch-state content
features.description: Imports 2-3 bundled launch-state lesson and question packs sourced from free public DMV handbooks into the local database.
features.answers_complaint: Source content from each state's free public DMV handbook.
acceptance_criteria: A fresh install with valid bundled assets shows 2-3 selectable state cards on State Selection.
If a pack contains a question with zero or two correct answers, import fails for that pack and the UI shows an invalid content error instead of starting a quiz.
Each imported question review displays its handbookSection and explanation on Quiz Results.
No network call is made to load lessons or questions.
features.implementation_notes: Ship app assets under assets/content/manifest.json and assets/content/{stateId}/pack.json. manifest.json contains an array of 2-3 state packs with stateId, displayName, handbookTitle, handbookSourceUrl, and version. Each pack.json contains lessons and questions. On first launch and whenever a pack version changes, ContentImporter reads the JSON with kotlinx.serialization, validates every lesson has non-empty title/bodyMarkdown, every question has exactly four AnswerOption records, exactly one correct option, non-empty explanation, and a handbookSection. If any selected state's pack fails validation, insert no partial rows for that state and expose an error state on State Selection/Home. Use Room transactions to delete and reinsert a changed state pack while preserving QuizAttempt, QuizAnswer, LessonProgress, UserPreference, and EntitlementCache rows.

features.name: First complete practice test before paywall
features.description: Lets a free learner complete one full practice test from start through results without a subscription prompt or forced unlock screen.
acceptance_criteria: A free first practice test containing 25 questions can advance from question 1 through question 25 without any unlock dialog or navigation to Unlock.
The unlock card first appears on Quiz Results after the completed free test, not during the test.
After completing the free full practice test, tapping Start practice test again routes to Unlock and does not create a new QuizAttempt.
A lifetime unlocked user can start repeated practice tests with no free-quota restriction.
features.implementation_notes: Create FreeAccessPolicy with states: BEFORE_FREE_TEST_COMPLETED, AFTER_FREE_TEST_COMPLETED, and LIFETIME_UNLOCKED. For a user without EntitlementCache.isOwned, Home Start practice test is enabled while no QuizAttempt exists where wasFreeFullPracticeTest=true and completedAtEpochMillis>0. Starting that test creates a PRACTICE_TEST attempt with 25 questions selected by deterministic shuffle using seed = stateId + current date epoch day + attempt UUID; if the selected state has fewer than 25 questions, use all available questions and treat that as the full test. During an active attempt with wasFreeFullPracticeTest=true, Quiz never navigates to Unlock and never displays purchase UI between questions. Only after the final answer is saved and completedAtEpochMillis is set does Quiz Results show an unlock card. After that completed attempt, any new practice test or locked lesson quiz start by a non-owner routes to Unlock before creating an attempt.

features.name: Transparent one-time lifetime unlock
features.description: Sells a single $4.99 lifetime unlock through Google Play Billing with no trial and no recurring subscription product.
features.answers_complaint: Price unaffordable for the actual audience
acceptance_criteria: The code contains no ProductType.SUBS query and no subscription product id.
Unlock screen copy includes 'One-time lifetime unlock' and 'No weekly subscription. No trial.'
A successful test purchase sets EntitlementCache.isOwned=true and unlocks additional practice tests without restarting the app.
Restore purchase calls queryPurchasesAsync(ProductType.INAPP) and updates the purchase status row in Settings.
features.implementation_notes: Configure exactly one Google Play in-app product id: lifetime_unlock. Do not configure any SUBS product, free trial, introductory pricing, weekly price, or account-based cancellation flow. BillingRepository uses BillingClient.startConnection, queryProductDetailsAsync for ProductType.INAPP with productId lifetime_unlock, launchBillingFlow from Unlock, PurchasesUpdatedListener to handle OK/PENDING/USER_CANCELED, and queryPurchasesAsync(ProductType.INAPP) on app start and when Restore purchase is tapped. On PURCHASED, acknowledge unacknowledged purchases with acknowledgePurchase and set EntitlementCache(productId='lifetime_unlock', isOwned=true). UI price text must display the localized ProductDetails oneTimePurchaseOfferDetails formattedPrice; the Play Console product should be priced at $4.99 as assumed by the report.

features.name: No deceptive trial or cancellation surface
features.description: Avoids trial billing confusion by never offering a trial and by explaining that the app uses only a one-time Play purchase.
acceptance_criteria: Searching the app strings for 'trial', 'weekly', '$7.99', 'cancel subscription', and 'delete account' finds no purchase-offer copy except the required disclosure phrase 'no free trial'.
Tapping Restore purchase when the test account owns lifetime_unlock changes the UI to lifetime unlocked.
When BillingClient returns ITEM_ALREADY_OWNED, the UI displays a restored state and does not show an error.
features.implementation_notes: Because v1 has no subscription and no app account, Settings and Unlock must not contain trial duration text, cancellation instructions, delete-account controls, or recurring billing language. Add a static pricing disclosure component reused on Unlock and Settings: 'This app uses one optional one-time Google Play purchase. There is no subscription, no free trial, and no in-app account to cancel.' Keep the Restore purchase button for users who reinstall. If BillingClient returns ITEM_ALREADY_OWNED, immediately call queryPurchasesAsync(INAPP), update EntitlementCache, and show 'Purchase restored' rather than asking the user to buy again.

features.name: Lesson and quiz study flow
features.description: Provides handbook-based lessons, lesson quizzes, full practice tests, answer explanations, and review results.
acceptance_criteria: Opening a lesson displays the title, handbook section, and body text from Room.
A lesson quiz contains only questions whose lessonId matches that lesson.
A full practice test draws questions from more than one lesson when the state pack contains multiple lessons with questions.
Quiz Results shows correct and incorrect answers distinctly and includes the explanation for every question.
features.implementation_notes: Home lists Lesson rows ordered by Lesson.sortOrder for the selected state. Lesson screen renders bodyMarkdown using a simple parser that supports paragraphs and bullet lines starting with '- '; no webview is used. A LESSON_QUIZ attempt uses all questions for that lesson, capped at 10 by deterministic shuffle if more than 10 exist. A PRACTICE_TEST attempt uses 25 questions across all lessons, or all available if fewer than 25. Quiz stores each selected answer immediately in QuizAnswer so process death does not lose progress; when the last question is answered, compute scoreCorrect from QuizAnswer.isCorrect, set completedAtEpochMillis, and navigate to results/{attemptId}. Results shows each question, selected answer, correct answer, explanation, and handbookSection.

features.name: Local progress tracking
features.description: Tracks selected state, lesson completion, quiz attempts, scores, and free-test eligibility entirely on device.
acceptance_criteria: After completing a quiz and force-stopping/reopening the app, Home still shows the completed attempt in progress calculations.
Changing state and then switching back preserves the first state's lesson and quiz progress.
Deleting EntitlementCache does not falsely reset the used free practice test because eligibility is derived from QuizAttempt history.
An unfinished attempt can be resumed or exited without being counted as the completed free full practice test.
features.implementation_notes: Use Room DAOs returning Flow for Home progress. Mark LessonProgress.readCompleted=true when the learner reaches the bottom of the Lesson screen and taps 'Mark read' or starts that lesson's quiz. Home progress summary calculates completedLessons / totalLessons and completed practice tests where quizMode='PRACTICE_TEST' and completedAtEpochMillis>0. Free-test eligibility is derived from EntitlementCache plus existence of a completed wasFreeFullPracticeTest attempt; do not store a separate mutable free-quota flag. Switching selected state changes UserPreference selected_state_id but does not delete progress for other states.

features.name: Polished teen-friendly UI states
features.description: Provides clear empty, loading, locked, error, and purchased states so the app feels fair rather than coercive.
acceptance_criteria: Every screen in the navigation graph has an explicit loading state and at least one populated state in code.
A billing unavailable state does not block the first free practice test before it has been completed.
A missing results attempt id shows an error with a Back to Home action instead of crashing.
A locked screen always has an affordance to return without purchasing.
features.implementation_notes: Implement each screen as a state holder ViewModel exposing sealed UI state classes matching the states listed in the screens section. Locked states must still explain why the user is seeing Unlock and must include a Back button. Empty content states must identify whether the selected state has no lessons, no questions, or no valid content pack. Error messages should be plain-language and recoverable where possible: invalid content returns to State Selection, billing unavailable keeps free test usable if not consumed, and missing attempt id returns to Home.

non_goals: No weekly, monthly, or trial subscription in v1.
No nationwide 50-state rollout in v1; scope is 2-3 launch-state content packs sourced from public DMV handbooks.
No AI-generated questions, chat tutor, or image generation.
No accounts, cloud sync, leaderboards, or server-side progress backup.
No guarantee of passing the permit test; the app is study prep based on public handbook material.

steps: Install a fresh debug build with valid bundled content containing at least 25 questions for the selected state.
Launch the app, choose the first state in State Selection, and tap Continue.
On Home, tap Start practice test.
For questions 1 through 25, select the first visible answer option and tap Next.
After each of questions 1 through 24, assert that the current route remains quiz/{quizMode}/{lessonId} and that no Unlock screen or billing dialog is visible.
After answering question 25, wait for navigation to Quiz Results.
test_plan.expected: The free first practice test reaches Quiz Results only after the final question, with no paywall, unlock route, or purchase prompt shown during questions 1-25.

steps: Complete the first free practice test in a fresh install.
From Quiz Results, tap Back to Home.
Tap Start practice test again without purchasing.
test_plan.expected: The app navigates to Unlock before creating another QuizAttempt, and the Unlock screen explains the one-time lifetime unlock.

steps: Instantiate the billing product request builder used by BillingRepository.
Inspect the Product list passed to queryProductDetailsAsync.
Inspect all product ids and product types configured in the repository.
test_plan.expected: The only configured product is productId lifetime_unlock with ProductType.INAPP; there are zero ProductType.SUBS entries.
test_plan.scenario: Price unaffordable for the actual audience

steps: Open Unlock on a build connected to the Play Billing test environment.
Read all purchase-related copy on Unlock.
Open Settings and read all purchase-related copy.
Tap Buy lifetime unlock and complete a license tester purchase.
Return to Settings and tap Restore purchase.
test_plan.expected: The app never offers a trial or subscription, displays the localized one-time product price expected to be $4.99, unlocks after purchase, and Restore purchase shows the owned lifetime unlock.

steps: Create an in-memory Room database.
Run ContentImporter on a test manifest with two valid state packs and one invalid pack whose question has two correct options.
Collect inserted StatePack, Lesson, Question, and AnswerOption rows.
test_plan.expected: The two valid packs are imported with their handbookSourceUrl values, the invalid pack is rejected without partial rows, and each imported question has exactly four options with exactly one correct option.
test_plan.scenario: Source content from each state's free public DMV handbook.

steps: Launch the app, select a state, and open the first lesson from Home.
Scroll to the bottom of the lesson and tap Mark read.
Return to Home.
Reopen the app process.
Open the same state Home screen again.
test_plan.expected: The lesson remains marked complete after process restart and Home progress reflects one completed lesson.

steps: Start a lesson quiz from a lesson that has at least three questions.
Answer every question, deliberately choosing at least one incorrect answer when possible.
On Quiz Results, expand or view each review row.
test_plan.expected: Quiz Results shows the total score, selected answer, correct answer, explanation, and handbook section for every question.

libraries.purpose: Android activity integration for Jetpack Compose screens
Compose navigation graph for screen routing
Lifecycle-aware ViewModels used by Compose screens
Lifecycle runtime Kotlin extensions for app startup and coroutine scopes
Room local database runtime for bundled content, progress, attempts, and entitlement cache
Room annotation processor for DAO and entity code generation
Kotlin serialization for parsing bundled public-handbook JSON content assets
Google Play one-time in-app purchase integration

positioning: A DMV permit prep app that lets a teen finish a complete practice test before seeing any paywall and offers a single affordable lifetime unlock instead of a weekly subscription.

design_system.typography: Material 3 default type scale, no custom font
design_system.theme_notes: Use Material 3 dynamic color disabled so screenshots are deterministic. Light theme uses #FAF8F2 background, #1E6B5E primary, dark theme uses #101815 background with the same primary shifted only by Material color roles. Quiz answer cards are white in light mode and #1B211F in dark mode; correct answers use #2E7D32 and incorrect answers use #B3261E.

store_listing.title: PermitFair DMV Prep
store_listing.icon_prompt: Create a clean Android launcher icon for a DMV learner permit prep app. Use a rounded square background in warm off-white #FAF8F2 with a centered simple car glyph in deep teal #1E6B5E, plus a small checkmark badge in green to suggest passing a practice test. Flat vector style, high contrast, no text, no state seals, no official government markings.
store_listing.long_description:
PermitFair DMV Prep helps new drivers study from public DMV handbook material without the frustrating mid-test paywall. Start with your launch-state content pack, read short handbook-based lessons, take quizzes, and complete a full practice test before any unlock prompt appears.

Why it is different:
• One complete free practice test before the paywall
• One optional $4.99 lifetime unlock
• No weekly subscription
• No free trial billing
• No account required
• Lessons and explanations based on public DMV handbook content

Designed for teen permit learners who need straightforward practice at a fair price.
store_listing.short_description: Finish a free DMV practice test before a fair one-time unlock.

project_context: This spec describes an independent, alternative Android app you are building from scratch to compete with an existing incumbent app on Google Play — not a modification, clone, or reskin of the incumbent's own code, assets, or branding. Use the incumbent only as a market reference (via the report data below), and design working_name/package_id/store_listing/design_system so the result is clearly its own product.
build_instructions:
./gradlew clean
./gradlew testDebugUnitTest
./gradlew connectedDebugAndroidTest
keytool -genkeypair -v -keystore release.keystore -storepass permitfair-release-pass -keypass permitfair-release-pass -alias permitfair -keyalg RSA -keysize 2048 -validity 10000 -dname "CN=PermitFair, OU=SoloBuilder, O=PermitFair, L=Internet, S=NA, C=US"
ORG_GRADLE_PROJECT_RELEASE_STORE_FILE=$PWD/release.keystore ORG_GRADLE_PROJECT_RELEASE_STORE_PASSWORD=permitfair-release-pass ORG_GRADLE_PROJECT_RELEASE_KEY_ALIAS=permitfair ORG_GRADLE_PROJECT_RELEASE_KEY_PASSWORD=permitfair-release-pass ./gradlew bundleRelease
